segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Thanks for making time, Omar. Let us go through the notetaker pilot and your development plan.

segments.speaker: Omar Nasser
segments.text: The redaction module is done; I still need to finish the glossary loader and the tests.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Good. I will get you access to the GPU test server by Friday so you can run the Arabic bake-off.

segments.speaker: Omar Nasser
segments.text: I will finish the glossary loader and its tests by the twenty-third.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: On development: we agreed you take the MLOps certification this quarter, and the bank covers the fee.

segments.speaker: Omar Nasser
segments.text: One concern: the Arabic model licence is gated, and I am not sure Compliance has signed off.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: I will raise the licence question with Compliance this week.

segments.speaker: Omar Nasser
segments.text: Question for you: do we keep the raw audio after approval? Legal asked me twice.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Not decided yet. Let us take it up with the DPO.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: Next one-to-one on the thirtieth of September. Thanks, Omar.
